# API reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Core modeling seam

Author a typed model, bind data, fit it, and inspect a named result.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [spec.terms.Spec](Spec.qmd#fmrimod.spec.terms.Spec) | An ordered collection of event and baseline terms. |
| [spec.terms.Term](Term.qmd#fmrimod.spec.terms.Term) | Marker base class for spec terms. |
| [spec.builders.hrf](spec_hrf.qmd#fmrimod.spec.builders.hrf) | Build an `HrfTerm`. |
| [spec._compile.compile](compile.qmd#fmrimod.spec._compile.compile) | Lower a Spec or single Term to ``(EventModel, BaselineModel)``. |
| [dataset.constructors.fmri_dataset](fmri_dataset.qmd#fmrimod.dataset.constructors.fmri_dataset) | Construct the canonical `FmriDataset` from an image source. |
| [dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset](FmriDataset.qmd#fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset) | fMRI dataset combining time-series data with experimental events. |
| [design.realized.RealizedDesign](RealizedDesign.qmd#fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign) | A named, already-realized design matrix. |
| [model.config.FmriLmConfig](FmriLmConfig.qmd#fmrimod.model.config.FmriLmConfig) | Complete configuration for GLM fitting. |
| [contrast.semantic.condition](condition.qmd#fmrimod.contrast.semantic.condition) | Author a condition-level reference for semantic contrasts. |
| [contrast.contrast_spec.column_contrast](column_contrast.qmd#fmrimod.contrast.contrast_spec.column_contrast) | Define a contrast by targeting design matrix columns using regex patterns. |
| [glm.combine.combine_runs](combine_runs.qmd#fmrimod.glm.combine.combine_runs) | Pool per-run `FmriLm` fits into a combined result. |
| [glm.contrasts.ContrastResult](ContrastResult.qmd#fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult) | Result of evaluating a contrast on GLM output. |
| [contrast.group_collection.group_dataset_from_contrasts](group_dataset_from_contrasts.qmd#fmrimod.contrast.group_collection.group_dataset_from_contrasts) | Lower one first-level contrast per subject into a ``GroupDataset``. |
| [baseline.baseline_model.baseline_model](baseline_model.qmd#fmrimod.baseline.baseline_model.baseline_model) | Construct a baseline model for fMRI time series. |
| [single.typed.fmri_lss](fmri_lss.qmd#fmrimod.single.typed.fmri_lss) | Run Mumford LSS single-trial estimation through the typed Spec surface. |
| [single.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset](estimate_single_trial_from_dataset.qmd#fmrimod.single.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset) | Estimate per-trial betas from an FmriDataset and trialwise spec. |
| [glm.matrix.fit_glm_from_matrix](fit_glm_from_matrix.qmd#fmrimod.glm.matrix.fit_glm_from_matrix) | Fit a matrix-design GLM and return a full ``FmriLm`` result. |
| [glm.matrix.fit_glm_from_suffstats](fit_glm_from_suffstats.qmd#fmrimod.glm.matrix.fit_glm_from_suffstats) | Build an ``FmriLm`` result from OLS sufficient statistics. |
| [simulate.bold.simulate_bold](simulate_bold.qmd#fmrimod.simulate.bold.simulate_bold) | Simulate BOLD time series from a design matrix and true betas. |

## Group, BIDS, and results

Build group inputs, run native or statistical interfaces, and write outputs.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [group.dataset.GroupDataset](GroupDataset.qmd#fmrimod.group.dataset.GroupDataset) | Materialized group-analysis data. |
| [group.reducers.ols_voxelwise](ols_voxelwise.qmd#fmrimod.group.reducers.ols_voxelwise) | OLS reducer across subjects for each sample/contrast feature. |
| [group.typed.fmri_group_lm](fmri_group_lm.qmd#fmrimod.group.typed.fmri_group_lm) | Fit a group-level / second-level GLM. |
| [stats.inference.group_fit](group_fit.qmd#fmrimod.stats.inference.group_fit) | Canonical second-level interface with parity-oriented normalization. |
| [stats.meta.fmri_meta](fmri_meta.qmd#fmrimod.stats.meta.fmri_meta) | Fit group-level meta-regression for parity-oriented workflows. |
| [stats.ttest.fmri_ttest](fmri_ttest.qmd#fmrimod.stats.ttest.fmri_ttest) | Run a parity-oriented one-sample group t-test. |
| [bids.stats_model.load_stats_model](load_stats_model.qmd#fmrimod.bids.stats_model.load_stats_model) | Load a BIDS Stats Model JSON document. |
| [bids.export.write_contrasts](write_contrasts.qmd#fmrimod.bids.export.write_contrasts) | Write contrast statistic maps as NIfTI files. |
| [io.results.write_results](write_results.qmd#fmrimod.io.results.write_results) | Write fitted model results as NIfTI files plus a manifest JSON. |
| [dataset.group_data.group_data_from_fmrilm](group_data_from_fmrilm.qmd#fmrimod.dataset.group_data.group_data_from_fmrilm) | Construct group data from first-level model results. |

## Design and events

Build event terms and design matrices from fMRI timing tables.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [sampling.SamplingFrame](SamplingFrame.qmd#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame) | fMRI acquisition timing specification. |
| [design.event_model.event_model](event_model.qmd#fmrimod.design.event_model.event_model) | Create an event model from a formula, term list, or builder. |
| [design.design_matrix.design_matrix](design_matrix.qmd#fmrimod.design.design_matrix.design_matrix) | Extract or construct a design matrix. |
| [design_colmap.design_colmap](design_colmap.qmd#fmrimod.design_colmap.design_colmap) | Get structured column metadata for a design matrix. |
| [events.factor.EventFactor](EventFactor.qmd#fmrimod.events.factor.EventFactor) | Categorical event with discrete levels. |
| [events.variable.EventVariable](EventVariable.qmd#fmrimod.events.variable.EventVariable) | Continuous event with numeric values. |
| [events.matrix.EventMatrix](EventMatrix.qmd#fmrimod.events.matrix.EventMatrix) | Multi-column event representation. |
| [event_term](event_term.qmd#fmrimod.event_term) | Construct an event term from one or more events. |

## HRFs and regressors

Specify HRFs and convolve event timing into regressors.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [hrf](hrf.qmd#fmrimod.hrf) | HRF module. |
| [hrf_formula](hrf_formula.qmd#fmrimod.hrf_formula) | HRF formula function. See `fmrimod.formula.functional.hrf`. |
| [convolve.convolve](convolve.qmd#fmrimod.convolve.convolve) | Convolve event(s) with hemodynamic response function. |
| [convolve_design](convolve_design.qmd#fmrimod.convolve_design) | Design matrix convolution functionality. |
| [regressor.core.regressor](regressor.qmd#fmrimod.regressor.core.regressor) | Create a Regressor object. |
| [regressors.regressors](regressors.qmd#fmrimod.regressors.regressors) | Extract regressors from an event model or event term. |
| [trialwise.trialwise](trialwise.qmd#fmrimod.trialwise.trialwise) | Generate one regressor per trial (plus an optional grand-mean column). |

## Contrasts and validation

Create contrast weights and validate design-matrix structure.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [contrast.contrast_spec.contrast](contrast.qmd#fmrimod.contrast.contrast_spec.contrast) | Define a linear contrast using a formula expression. |
| [contrast.contrast_weights.contrast_weights](contrast_weights.qmd#fmrimod.contrast.contrast_weights.contrast_weights) | Compute contrast weights for a specification. |
| [contrast.fcontrast.Fcontrasts](Fcontrasts.qmd#fmrimod.contrast.fcontrast.Fcontrasts) | Generate F-contrast matrices for testing main effects and interactions. |
| [validate.validate_contrasts](validate_contrasts.qmd#fmrimod.validate.validate_contrasts) | Validate contrast weights against a design matrix or event model. |
| [validate.check_collinearity](check_collinearity.qmd#fmrimod.validate.check_collinearity) | Check a design matrix for multicollinearity. |
| [residualize.residualize](residualize.qmd#fmrimod.residualize.residualize) | Residualize data by projecting out a design matrix. |

## GLM and single-trial models

Fit GLMs and estimate trial-wise responses.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [glm.fmri_lm.fmri_lm](fmri_lm.qmd#fmrimod.glm.fmri_lm.fmri_lm) | Fit a GLM to fMRI data. |
| [glm.compat.fmri_ols_fit](fmri_ols_fit.qmd#fmrimod.glm.compat.fmri_ols_fit) | Fit matrix OLS and return beta, SE, and t matrices. |
| [glm.compat.compute_lm_contrasts](compute_lm_contrasts.qmd#fmrimod.glm.compat.compute_lm_contrasts) | Compute t/F contrast statistics from fitted GLM matrices. |
| [betas.extraction.estimate_betas](estimate_betas.qmd#fmrimod.betas.extraction.estimate_betas) | Estimate trial-wise betas. |
| [glm_ols](glm_ols.qmd#fmrimod.glm_ols) | Estimate trial-wise OLS betas. |
| [glm_lss](glm_lss.qmd#fmrimod.glm_lss) | Estimate trial-wise LSS betas. |
| [single.estimate_single_trial](estimate_single_trial.qmd#fmrimod.single.estimate_single_trial) | Estimate per-trial betas using the specified method. |
| [single.lss.lss_single_trial](lss_single_trial.qmd#fmrimod.single.lss.lss_single_trial) | Vectorized LSS estimation. |
| [single.lsa.lsa_single_trial](lsa_single_trial.qmd#fmrimod.single.lsa.lsa_single_trial) | Estimate trial-wise betas via standard OLS (all trials simultaneous). |

## Simulation and summaries

Generate small synthetic examples and convert common statistics.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [simulate.dataset.simulate_simple_dataset](simulate_simple_dataset.qmd#fmrimod.simulate.dataset.simulate_simple_dataset) | Simulate a small multi-condition dataset with additive Gaussian noise. |
| [simulate.compat.simulate_bold_signal](simulate_bold_signal.qmd#fmrimod.simulate.compat.simulate_bold_signal) | Simulate condition-wise BOLD signals for a simple event design. |
| [simulate.compat.simulate_noise_vector](simulate_noise_vector.qmd#fmrimod.simulate.compat.simulate_noise_vector) | Simulate a 1D fMRI-like noise series with ARMA + drift + physiology. |
| [simulate.compat.simulate_fmri_matrix](simulate_fmri_matrix.qmd#fmrimod.simulate.compat.simulate_fmri_matrix) | Simulate an fMRI matrix dataset plus generation metadata. |
| [stats.inference.t_to_d](t_to_d.qmd#fmrimod.stats.inference.t_to_d) | Convert t-statistics to standardized effect sizes and variances. |
| [stats.inference.r_to_z](r_to_z.qmd#fmrimod.stats.inference.r_to_z) | Convert correlations to Fisher Z and sampling variance. |
| [stats.inference.z_to_r](z_to_r.qmd#fmrimod.stats.inference.z_to_r) | Back-transform Fisher Z to correlation. |
